# ADR-3085: A08: Unsigned update payload for client 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unsigned updates enable supply-chain takeover.

## Decision

Update agents SHALL NOT apply an unsigned update payload for client 1 (A08-1).

## Consequences

Signatures verify against pinned public keys.
